config.grain_rationale: Each record is a legal entity (identified by ABN) with its tax information for an income year. The business participant's legal name and ABN are mapped; the financial figures are outside the ontology.

record_id.rationale: Neither Name (526 distinct/527) nor ABN (524 distinct/527, 2 missing) is unique per record, so a content hash is the traceable record id.

fields.rationale: The ATO corporate tax transparency report lists entities by their registered legal name; names carry legal-form suffixes (PTY LTD, PTY LIMITED, LIMITED).
ABN column is 11 digits and 100% checksum-valid across the discovery partition; 2 records legitimately have no ABN.

unmapped.reason: Financial figure (total income) not in the ontology.
Financial figure (taxable income) not in the ontology.
Financial figure (tax payable) not in the ontology.
Tax income year the figures relate to; not an entity attribute, and not a statement of when the name/ABN claim was observed. Kept as an observation-level fact only.

config.notes: Mapped the main data sheet 'Income tax details'. The 'Information' sheet is front-matter with no tabular records; the 'PRRT details' sheet (16 records: Name, ABN, PRRT Payable $) is a separate supplementary table not covered by this config. Restricting to one sheet keeps one row = one legal entity; no publisher documentation was supplied, so semantics rest on the sheet headers and the report's published structure.
